pages.text: Deal the specified amount and type of damage to selected entities, subject to damage type and vanilla damage rules.

pages.title: Default Aether Cost
pages.text: Per target and attempt: m(d)=k*(500*d+12.5*d*d). d is requested damage; ordinary damage uses k=1.

pages.title: Structural Complexity
pages.text: 0.1, regardless of damage, effect level or number of targets.
